v2_findings.content:

Your equipment breakdown insurance is $49 million — appropriate for industrial printing presses and sorting equipment. If a press blows up, you're well-covered for repair and lost income. Maintain. Verify cloud-computing service interruption coverage covers all critical SaaS dependencies.

v2_findings.title: Property — Interruption of Computer Operations Sublimit
v2_findings.content:
[Bad] Property — Interruption of Computer Operations Sublimit
Risk Score: 9/25

What this means:
If a sprinkler discharge or HVAC failure damaged your data systems and shut down ballot processing for two weeks, your business income insurance pays $2,500. That's about 30 minutes of operations for a company your size. Your cyber policy only responds if the cause is cyber — a sprinkler isn't cyber

Recommendation:
Increase Interruption of Computer Operations sublimit to $1M-$2M at renewal. Hanover Premium Choice or similar should be available.

v2_findings.title: Per-Project Aggregate Cap Limitation
v2_findings.content:
[Bad] Per-Project Aggregate Cap Limitation
Risk Score: 6/25

What this means:
Your GL gives you separate aggregate limits for each project — but only up to $2 million total across the policy. So if you have multiple counties claiming damages in the same year, the sum can't exceed $2 million on the primary GL. Above that, your $10 million umbrella picks up — so in practice thi

Recommendation:
At renewal, push to remove or significantly increase the $2M policy aggregate cap. Confirm umbrella follow-form attaches at $2M for GL.
